title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E18 — Chariot of Gold
A sinister society drugs Bonnie to reprogram KITT for a museum robbery; guest Theodore Bikel.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E19 — White Bird
Michael's ex-fiancee (Catherine Hickland) is implicated in her attorney boss's underworld dealings.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E7 — Dealer's Wild
DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E8 — Nurses Wild
The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E9 — Publicity Hound
Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E10 — Weird Wednesday
The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E11 — Dilemma
Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E12 — Hangup
Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E13 — Crash
Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E1 — Problem
DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E2 — Kids
Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E18 — The Duke of Whispering Pines
B.A.'s old girlfriend (Sheila DeWindt) calls on him to find her investor husband, B.A.'s former school rival.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E19 — Beneath the Surface
The team helps Face's old high-school buddy (Tom Villard) locate a sunken Spanish galleon filled with treasure.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E20 — Mission of Peace
The team outmaneuvers swindlers plotting to evict a group of enterprising senior citizens; guest Jason Evers.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E21 — The Trouble With Harry
A mobster, avenging his brother's death, stalks an alcoholic ex-boxer; guests Hulk Hogan, William "The Refrigerator" Perry.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E22 — A Little Town With an Accent
A crafty mobster (Mark Lawrence) fakes his own death to avoid prison and plots to take over a town.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E23 — The Sound of Thunder
The search for the half-Vietnamese daughter (Tia Carrere) of Gen. Fulbright leads the team to a resourceful teenager bent on vengeance.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E1 — Dishpan Man
Gen. Stockwell (Robert Vaughn) blackmails the team into rescuing hostages held on board a Mexican airliner by terrorists.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E2 — Trial by Fire
The team faces court-martial in the murder of a colonel who was cooperating with the enemy; guest David Ackroyd.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E3 — Firing Line
Murdock and Frankie Santana ask Gen. Stockwell to help them rescue B.A., Hannibal and Face from a military firing squad.
